basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer living in Santa Rosa, California. I recently joined Reddit to connect with communities that resonate with my interests, especially during the pandemic. I love exploring new hobbies and have recently dived into the world of vaporizers and Warhammer 40k models. I work from home, which gives me the flexibility to browse Reddit during my breaks. I'm in a long-term relationship, and we both enjoy hiking in the beautiful Sonoma County outdoors. I'm usually online in the evenings, Pacific Time. Dislikes include negativity and unnecessary drama.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design and have been working in the field for about 5 years. My interest in vaporizers is more recent, sparked by discussions with friends and online research. I also have a budding interest in model painting, particularly Warhammer 40k, which I picked up during the pandemic.
